name: forge
description: Connect project knowledge to correct agent work and clear human explanations, with task-specific context, source tracking, proportional planning, and verified outcomes.

interface.shortDescription: Clear outcomes, durable contracts, proportionate execution.
interface.longDescription: Forge connects human intent and project knowledge to correct agent work and clear explanations. Agents select the sources, conditions and exceptions needed for a task; people get explanations suited to their questions and decisions. Optional source capture and change checks preserve provenance independently of layout. Plans use clear outcomes and source links without a fixed parser grammar. Document constraints are judged by their contribution to correctness and understanding, not legacy compatibility. Verification distinguishes selected byte equality, source meaning, actual behavior and reader understanding. Forge also includes proportional planning, debugging, optional TDD, UI verification, cross-agent extension authoring and house writing guidance.
defaultPrompt: Fix this bounded local bug through the Quick route and show fresh focused evidence.

Create one skill and MCP bundle for Codex, Claude Code, and Antigravity.
Verify this dashboard change preserves input state and recovers from save failures.
Validate this flexible structured Markdown spec without generating HTML.
Create a Visual Doc for this spec only for this review request.
